description: Makes one of Foliopeak's reports from the person's own figures and gives a short summary and the link to open it, ready to read or save as a PDF: monthly (the Monthly Review), own-owe (every account and debt with their share - for a mortgage, a solicitor or probate), accountant (a limited company director's 12-month pay plan with questions), tax (allowances used and left), performance, life-choices (a what-if beside how things are now). Use for 'make me my monthly review', 'a report for my accountant', 'something I can print'. Changes nothing. The answer carries the link to the report.
name: get_report
title: Make a report
